profile.headline: Software Engineer at Uber Freight
profile.summary:
Senior full-stack developer with a track record of delivering scalable, customer-facing applications and APIs. Deep experience across JavaScript, Node.js, React, and Golang, with a focus on system design, performance, and maintainability. Comfortable owning complex features end-to-end and collaborating closely with product, design, and platform teams to deliver reliable, high-impact solutions.

You can view my open source projects at: https://github.com/amkirwan

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Uber Freight, I lead initiatives across new product lines and core customer platforms, focusing on building performant, scalable systems that streamline freight logistics for shippers and operations teams.

Parcel E2E Platform: Lead frontend developer for Uber Freight’s new Parcel service, developing multiple applications for Customers, Shippers, and internal Ops teams.

ERP Integration: Led frontend development of a new UI to integrate with ERP systems, allowing users to create shipments directly from their business platforms.

Shipper Platform Enhancements:

Designed and delivered key customer-facing features to create and manage LTL/FTL and cross-border shipments.

Implemented pre-authorization with credit cards to enable instant load creation post-signup.

Led a complete refactor of major workflows to modernize UX and improve performance.

Onboarded and mentored new engineers and a remote team to scale delivery velocity and maintain product quality.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to building core freight automation and quoting infrastructure powering Uber Freight’s operational excellence and customer quoting experiences.

Freight Automation: Developed a Node.js and Puppeteer-based framework to automate quoting/bidding on external freight portals without APIs. Integrated directly with partner APIs where available to streamline Ops workflows and improve response times.

Quoting & Booking API: Built and optimized Uber Freight’s high-performance Go (Golang) API supporting both LTL and FTL quoting and booking.

API Guardrails Initiative: Led backend development to implement guardrails that protect customers financially during quoting. Also built the frontend Ops tools for managing and monitoring these rules.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer III
positions.description:
I am currently a developer on the consumer facing Groupon Deal Page application which is served in 15 countries. Our main focus is on delivering a robust application using web standards that is performant and provides a great customer experience. Our Microservice Architecture often requires interacting with multiple development teams when working on new features, upgrading systems or troubleshooting issues. Our rigorous A/B testing allows us to iterate on new projects and features to find what works best for our users on our site. 

My role has involved developing new features that have improved user conversion and brought in additional revenue of more than $7.5m in 2018. In addition to feature work, my responsibilities have included on-boarding new developers to our team, training summer interns, and working with many different teams across Groupon.

Our team works as a distributed team with developers in SF, Santa Clara, Romania and Chicago.  We primarily use Node.js/Express, Preact/Redux, Stylus, Docker and ELK for development of Deal Page.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Full Stack Web Developer for Groupon Deal Page.

I am currently a developer on the consumer facing Groupon Deal Page application which is served in 15 countries. Our main focus is on delivering a robust application using web standards that is performant and provides a great customer experience. Our Microservice Architecture often requires interacting with multiple development teams when working on new features, upgrading systems or troubleshooting issues. Our rigorous A/B testing allows us to iterate on new projects and features to find what works best for our users on our site. 

We primarily use Node.js/Express, Preact/Redux, Stylus, Docker and ELK for development of Deal Page. 
 
In addition to Deal Page I am also a developer on Wishlist. I have been working on both the API portion written in Dropwizard/Java and the frontend written in Node/Express.js. Our API backend serves both our web and native applications allowing users to wishlist deals and view them across devices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently developing applications for the Anesthesia Department using Ruby on Rails, Ember.js, Bootstrap and PostgreSQL along with other technologies. In my role I am both the lead developer and the lead front end developer on several projects. I have spearheaded the usage of open source projects, TDD practices and using standards based HTML5 and CSS3 for our applications. 

In our latest projects I have focused on using Rails for the API portion of the site using the JSON API specification. For the front end I have been using Ember.js along with Socket.IO for realtime updating accross clients. For deployment I am using Docker along with Docker Compose and Docker Swarm. 

Over the past 3 ½ years I have been telecommuting from the Chicagoland area. Working remotely has required me to be responsible for being the lead on projects and to work in highly focused and self-directed manor.

positions.title: Lead System Support Analyst
positions.description: Develop solutions for both hardware and software based technical issues for department staff, doctors and researchers. Assist doctors and researchers with the purchase of computer equipment. Handle deployment of new computers, printers and other devices for the department. Work in partnership with other hospital IT staff to troubleshoot networking issues. Collaborate with fellow department IT members in the development of web-based applications for the department.
